=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/ci.yml:543-1041,3459-3472 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The required check `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator` (check-run 130810227544) is red, which also turns the `lint` aggregate (130831602621) red; the log tail ends on the expected `::error::[lint_pr_body_auto_close] ... #2734` fixture lines with no failing assertion or traceback, so the step that actually failed is unknown.
  WHY: CI stays red and blocks merge. The cause could be this PR's changed `tests/test_plan_clarify_blocked_output.py` (ci.yml line 1041; the pre-push gate hid it because PyYAML is missing), log truncation, a job timeout, or a state-dependent test, and the failure has recurred across at least four PR heads. Severity disagreement: sonnet and luna said MAJOR, glm said NIT; the highest is used.
- scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:602-604 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The gate skips with `too_many_failed_jobs` when a first-attempt run has more than three failed jobs, even if all of them were caused by the release-download 5xx.
  WHY: A run with 4+ jobs that all failed because of the release-download outage gets a triage issue instead of a re-run, which defeats the goal of reducing triage noise for this outage.
- scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:583 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: Job-list parsing uses `.total_count <= 100` while `per_page=100` limits the fetch, so runs with more than 100 jobs fall back with `jobs_unreadable`.
  WHY: This fails open safely, but it needlessly skips the re-run gate for large matrix runs.
- scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:608-616 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The gate reads annotations for each failed job one at a time inside a loop.
  WHY: Each failed workflow run can cost 1 run GET, 1 jobs GET and up to 3 annotation GETs on the collect stage's critical path; this is bounded but expensive.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "At most 2 reads and 1 write per triaged failure," reusing the run read rather than making a second GET.
  expected_change_site: scripts/check_failure_triage.sh, triage_release_download_rerun_gate
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: On the `workflow_run` path the gate reads the run at line 550, the jobs at line 582, and annotations once per failed job at lines 607-608 (up to three), for up to 5 reads plus 1 POST. The run-read memoization at scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:1372-1376 covers the reuse half. agents.d/9120-release-download-rerun.md records this as an above-budget deviation, but the linked issue does not defer or waive the two-read requirement. Severity disagreement: gemini and luna said MAJOR, minimax said NIT.
- requirement: "A consumer check that failed only because a github.com release download returned 502/503/504 is re-run once automatically, and no triage issue is filed for that first failure."
  expected_change_site: scripts/check_failure_triage.sh, triage_release_download_rerun_gate
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The gate exits to normal triage with `too_many_failed_jobs` at scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:602-604 when there are more than 3 failed jobs, before it checks annotations or sends the re-run request. `test_more_than_three_failed_jobs_are_filed` in tests/test_check_failure_triage_release_download_rerun.py codifies this, and README.md:2743 documents it ("it must have 1 to 3 failed jobs"). The issue does not restrict re-runs to runs with at most three failed jobs. Severity disagreement: luna said MAJOR, minimax said NIT and called it an implementation choice.
- requirement: PR description "Inherited failures" (pre-push gate failure on tests-hooks-and-orchestrator)
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/ci.yml, job tests-hooks-and-orchestrator
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: Minimax rated this failure unrelated to the PR (NIT). The failing step runs tests/test_lint_pr_body_auto_close.py, which this PR does not change; the log tail ends inside that step with no failing assertion or traceback after the expected ::error:: fixture lines for issue #2734; and tests-release-and-log-analysis, which collects the new cases through tests/test_check_failure_triage_workflow_security.py, passes.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
